maria_cs: Heads-up — looks like a noisy run from the onboarding playbook this morning, customers got repeated nudges.
ben_playbooks: ugh, any run ids or rule names so I can look?
maria_cs: run_id: run_20260412_0712, rule: onboarding_nudge_v3. healthscore delta triggered it: 0.62 -> 0.41. Two sends within 6m.
ben_playbooks: can you paste the raw event (or the webhook payload)? suspect dedupe key.
maria_cs: payload snip:
```
{"account_id":"acct_84a1","last_touch_id":null,"healthscore":0.41,"trigger":"healthscore_change"}
```
looks like last_touch_id was null so dedupe key collapsed.
sanjay_dataeng: this matches the reweight rollout we did yesterday — we changed recency weighting and that can set last_touch_id -> null for legacy touch records.
ben_playbooks: our throttle uses `event.dedupe_key = last_touch_id` when present, falls back to `account_id` only if last_touch_id exists. if last_touch_id becomes null, we lose uniqueness.
tia_enablement: so the weight change indirectly stopped dedupe from working. not great.
maria_cs: impacted customers: 3 with tickets #CS-1234 #CS-1235 #CS-1238. CS ops already paused automated nudges for onboarding_nudge_v3 in admin console.
ben_playbooks: quick patch: change dedupe key to `account_id + ':' + (last_touch_id || event.transaction_id || '')` — that'll avoid collapse. I'll push hotfix to staging.
ben_playbooks: patch diff:
```
- dedupe_key = event.last_touch_id
+ dedupe_key = event.account_id + ':' + (event.last_touch_id || event.transaction_id || '')
```
maria_cs: I ran `/playbook pause onboarding_nudge_v3 --until 2026-04-12T09:00Z` to stop further sends.
playbook-bot: playbook paused: onboarding_nudge_v3 by maria_cs at 1839999000
sanjay_dataeng: I'll run backfill to populate last_touch_id where possible: `python backfill_dedupe.py --since 2026-04-12T06:00Z` — ETA ~8m. will emit counts when done.
ben_playbooks: after backfill + hotfix we'll re-enable throttle and run a dry-run mode for 30m to verify no duplicates.
tia_enablement: please add a note to enablement release doc to revert the healthscore reweight flag until we confirm behaviour.
maria_cs: I'll own the postmortem and file a remediation ticket in ops. Thanks for the quick loop everyone. :pray:
